# Advanced Automotive Concepts

> Advanced Automotive Concepts LLC (Lake Forest, California) is an authorized sales agent for Safelink Theft Recovery, Revv1 and Uplift BDC. It sells Safelink hidden GPS theft recovery to car, independent and powersport dealerships as a one-time F&I menu product, and sells the Safelink Bicycle GPS (GLS11) directly to riders. AAC is the agent, not the manufacturer; Safelink makes the products.

## Dealers
- [Home and dealer program](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/): F&I menu product, one-time cost, no monthly fees, about 60-second install, 24/7/365 recovery support, gross calculator, dealer FAQ.
- [Dealer dashboard](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/platform.html): live location, battery health, stock status and geofence alerts for every protected unit.
- [GForce vehicle hardware](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/product.html): specifications and recovery process.

## Riders
- [Safelink Bicycle GPS (GLS11)](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/bicycle-gps.html): $199, hides inside the handlebar or seat tube, 2-year battery, no monthly subscription (paid renewal after two years), its own GPS, 24/7/365 recovery support, rider FAQ.
- [Shipping, returns and tax](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/shipping-returns.html): UPS shipping paid by the customer, 30-day returns on unused devices.

- [Shop](https://advancedautomotiveconcepts.net/lineup.html): the full Safelink lineup, including products that are coming soon.
